decisions.decision: Preserve existing class IRIs and parent classes. Event and Effect denote information records describing an occurrence or reported outcome; Task denotes an execution process. ProcessSpecification denotes a specification. No new world occurrence or causal outcome is inferred from a record alone.
decisions.review: If future source instances use one term for both specification and occurrence, split the meanings with a reviewed migration; no such split is asserted by this release.

decisions.decision: Map ActionExecution.authorizationIri to ag:usesAuthorization (ObjectProperty) and ActionExecution.result to ag:executionResult (DatatypeProperty). Keep JSON input keys and the legacy ag:authorizationIri declaration for compatibility. ag:result remains the authorization decision. A second domain is not used as a union.

Preserve valid broad domain declarations. A domain entails type when a property is asserted; it neither requires a property value nor proves business applicability. Schema and Shape references determine required validation, and UI profiles determine presentation only.

Preserve CRK:ENG coordinates x east, y up, z signed shore distance and km units. Approximate footprints and bounding boxes are not exact geometry or geographic coordinates. ValidTime numeric values are kept in an ag:TimeInterval node with explicit clock/unit metadata; unanchored simulation time is never converted to xsd:dateTime.
decisions.review: A geographic transform or wall-clock epoch conversion requires an explicit CRS transform or clock anchor and is outside this release.

decisions.topic: FunctionBind / Stage / PlatformType definition and parent consistency
decisions.decision: Preserve existing IRIs and parents. FunctionBind denotes a context-dependent role (Role), distinct from the specification describing it. Stage denotes an actual process portion (Process), distinct from stage entries in ShellTemplate. PlatformType remains a type specification (InformationEntity); inScene is usage metadata and never changes its ontological category.
basis: tbox.json subClassOf: FunctionBind -> Role, Stage -> Process, PlatformType -> InformationEntity
tbox.json disjointness and the existing Process / InformationEntity distinction
The present registry preserves source identity; it is not evidence that every legacy catalog record has the correct type.
decisions.sourceReview: Legacy FunctionBind and Stage records may describe roles or process specifications rather than bearers or occurrences. Their data typing is explicitly pending individual review in class-definition-review.json. No occurrence, role bearer, authorization, subclass change, or equivalence is invented by this wording correction.

validationBoundaries: OWL RL closure with explicit contradiction checks is not a complete OWL 2 DL satisfiability decision.
An empty SHACL target set is uncovered, not passed.
Referenced objects absent from supplied data are reported; the converter does not manufacture their types.
Unmapped fields remain in original JSON and in the conversion report; no guessed RDF predicate is emitted.
